messages:
alex: Heads-up — experimenting with a circuit-breaker for embeddings ingress to handle oversized mixed-dim batches. want to prototype console hooks before broad rollout.

mira: what exact failure mode are we targeting? 413s, runtime OOMs, or noisy 500s?

alex: all of the above. pattern: clients send variable-dim arrays that blow up memory at the splitter; runtime returns 500/oom and console logs are too noisy to triage per-tenant.

jon: propose graded reaction: soft-fail -> emit telemetry + advice; hard-fail only after retries or if bytes threshold exceeded. avoids breaking benign clients.

mira: also need to capture dim-profile snapshot and payload bytes to Grafana so SRE can correlate incidents.

alex: plan: preflight middleware emits event `embed.preflight.{ok,soft_fail,hard_fail}` with tags tenant_id, dims_serialized (e.g. "768|1024"), dim_count, total_bytes, route, preflight_version. soft_fail returns 202 with header `x-embed-advice: split-suggested`. hard_fail returns 413.

sophie: console team: we want a per-route mini-viz: time-series of preflight outcomes + heatmap dims vs bytes. can we do without changing retention?

luis: we can add derived rollups from existing events; retention same, but will add an ingest rollup for percentiles of dims per tenant. cheap if done at ingest.

jon: rollout config: `ingress.safeguard.v1` per route with `mode: warn|enforce|off` and thresholds `{bytes: 5MB, dims: 2048, vector_count: 64}`. default warn.

alex: rollout: warn in canary for 1w, then enforce for 2% traffic, ramp if stable. add canary metric set for quick false-positive detection.

mira: we should emit a `dim_signature` hash for mixed-dim requests so we can group by client behavior instead of exact sequences. helps debug compatibility vs malformed payloads.

sophie: console: we can show dim_signature as a hover tip and allow filtering by signature; also add top-signatures leaderboard per tenant.

luis: telemetry schema note: dims array is awkward for indexing. suggest serialize as `768|1024` and include `dim_count`.

jon: agree. also cap dims sample length (dont log full arrays >100) for privacy and cost.

alex: will cap dims sample to first 50 entries and set `dims_truncated=true` when needed.

mira: preflight cost: does parsing add latency? we need to include it in P99 budget. small checks should be <1ms avg but monitor jitter.

jon: implement hybrid: synchronous quick checks on headers and first N bytes for immediate decision; expensive ops (signature calc, full parse) async to worker but must still produce telemetry.

alex: pushing prototype config to ingress repo:
```json
{
  "ingress": {
    "safeguard_v1": {
      "mode": "warn",
      "thresholds": { "bytes": 5242880, "dims": 2048, "vector_count": 64 },
      "sample_dims_limit": 50,
      "soft_fail_header": "x-embed-advice: split-suggested"
    }
  }
}
```

mira: add telemetry tag for `route_variant` (hosted/dedicated/private) so we can compare behavior across deployment types.

alex: done, will include route_variant.

sophie: timeline: can console deliver a staging MVP (heatmap + leaderboards) in 2 weeks?

luis: yes if events emitted this week; will wire rollups and add Grafana panel in staging.

jon: SDKs: consider optional client hints header `x-embed-shape: dims=768;count=8` to reduce false positives. preflight prefers header but validates it. need docs + SDK PRs.

alex: good idea. will draft SDK change and docs note.

mira: monitoring: track `preflight.soft_fail_ratio` and `preflight.hard_fail_rate` during rollout. alert low-severity if hard_fail_rate > 0.5% over 5m.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: `ingress/safeguard-v1` -> canary cluster (tag: canary-embed-safeguard). started at 1718123600.

alex: thanks — I'll add telemetry events and open console PR. will DM anyone who wants staging Grafana access. :eyes:

sophie: cool, i'll schedule a 30m sync after canary metrics populate. :+1:
